name: Chloramphenicol
dosing: Topical ophthalmic or systemic dosing varies — systemic use limited by toxicity
contraindications: History of aplastic anaemia or significant bone marrow disorders; hypersensitivity
interactions: Concurrent bone marrow-suppressing drugs may increase haematological toxicity
monitoring: With systemic use monitor full blood count regularly for bone marrow suppression; topical ophthalmic use does not require systemic monitoring
pregnancy: Use with caution systemically; topical ophthalmic use commonly used when indicated
sideEffects: Bone marrow suppression and aplastic anaemia (rare but serious) with systemic use; topical effects limited to ocular irritation
clinicalPearls: Topical ophthalmic chloramphenicol is widely used for conjunctivitis; systemic use reserved due to risk of severe haematological toxicity and requires specialist oversight
indication: Ophthalmic infections and selected systemic infections when benefits outweigh risks
